articles.title: UP POLITICAL WATCH: BJP and SP Step Up Outreach to Lodi Voters Ahead of 2027 Assembly Polls
articles.description: As the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections draw closer, political parties are intensifying efforts to connect with influential voter groups, with the Lodi community emerging as a key focus of electoral outreach. The BJP and Samajwadi Party have both recently highlighted prominent Lodi figures, signalling the community’s growing importance in Uttar Pradesh politics. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath paid tribute to freedom fighter and martyr Gulab Singh Lodi on his 91st martyrdom anniversary at Jhandewala Park in Aminabad, Lucknow. Remembering his contribution to India’s freedom struggle, Yogi said Gulab Singh Lodi challenged British rule and sacrificed his life while raising the national flag. The Chief Minister recalled that Gulab Singh Lodi, who was born into a farmer’s family in Unnao, participated actively in the freedom movement and was killed by British forces at a young age. vEarlier, Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav had paid tribute to Veerangana Avantibai Lodi on her birth anniversary on August 16. Yadav said the Samajwadi Party would continue working for the honour of the Lodi community. He also raised demands linked to Avantibai Lodi’s legacy, including a public holiday and a prominent statue. The parallel outreach by the BJP and SP highlights the electoral significance being attached to the Lodi community. The community is considered influential across several districts of Uttar Pradesh, making its support potentially important in the upcoming assembly contest.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ vs PM Modi’s BJP Team Meet | Pune & Delhi Buzz | News18
articles.description: A busy political day unfolds with Rahul Gandhi’s “Chhatron Ki Goonj” student outreach programme in Pune and Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s first interaction with the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers in Delhi.Rahul Gandhi reached Pune on August 22 for the women-focused edition of “Chhatron Ki Goonj”, part of Congress’s wider student outreach campaign. The programme focused on engaging young women and hearing their concerns, with education, equality and social issues among the themes discussed. The event also came amid tensions between ABVP and NSUI members outside COEP University, adding a political edge to Rahul Gandhi’s visit.In Delhi, BJP president Nitin Nabin chaired his first meeting with the party’s newly appointed 65-member national team, with discussions centred on organisational strengthening, grassroots outreach and preparations for upcoming Assembly elections. The new team has 51 new faces, marking the BJP’s biggest organisational reshuffle in more than a decade.Prime Minister Narendra Modi later met the new BJP team at party headquarters and posed for a group photograph with the newly appointed office-bearers. articles.title: US judge blocks Trump policy suspending visas for nationals of 75 countries
articles.description: A federal judge in New York has vacated a Trump administration policy that suspended the processing of visas from 75 countries, including Afghanistan, Iran, Russia and Somalia, whose nationals the Trump administration deemed likely to require public assistance in the United States. US District Judge Jeannette Vargas, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, set aside the policy Friday as "contrary to law and in excess of statutory authority." Secretary of State Marco Rubio exceeded his authority by issuing the policy, which "runs afoul" of the Immigration and Nationality Act by mandating "the refusal of visas to eligible applicants without any basis in law," the judge ruled. Vargas said the policy also undermines the congressional requirement that puts consular officers at the forefront of any visa decision.
